description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for RadGameRandom01 — Godot 4 + Python forensic audit

rules.name: GDScript: Stub function (pass-only body)
rules.message: Function with pass-only body — likely a stub in a 300+ file project
rules.suggestion: Implement the function or remove if unused. Track stub-to-implementation ratio.

rules.name: GDScript: _ready() with only variable assignment and no setup logic
rules.message: _ready() only assigns variables — no signal connections or initialization calls. May be incomplete.
rules.suggestion: Connect signals, initialize subsystems, or verify the node is properly set up in _ready()

rules.name: GDScript: Signal connection to non-existent method
rules.message: Signal connected to method that doesn't exist in the target script — runtime error
rules.suggestion: Add the method or fix the signal connection path

rules.name: GDScript: @onready reference to missing node
rules.message: @onready reference to node that doesn't exist in scene tree
rules.suggestion: Verify node path matches scene tree structure

rules.name: Python: Function with no docstring in tools directory
rules.message: Python tooling function without docstring — purpose unclear in Godot project context

rules.name: GDScript: autoload without singleton check
rules.message: Accessing autoload via get_node() — verify it's registered in project.godot as an autoload
rules.suggestion: Use the autoload name directly or register in Project Settings > Autoload

rules.name: GDScript: HTTPRequest without error handling
rules.message: HTTPRequest signal connected but callback doesn't check result code for errors
rules.suggestion: Check result in callback: if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS: push_error('Request failed')
